relations.evidence: Per Madan B. Lokur, J.: Whether sexual intercourse between a man and his wife being a girl between 15 and 18 years of age is rape? 1. Exception 2 to Section 375 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 (the IPC) answers this in the negative, but sexual intercourse with a girl below 18 years of age is rape regardless of whether she is married or not.
